reason: My first thought is always 'is it really tested', and this one names the lab and puts the batch report behind a QR code, so I can check it myself. At $24.99 with money back and nothing to send back, I'd try one box on a TikTok impulse.
objection: I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles, so I'm not sure I'll actually finish 30 days. And 'Made in China' makes me want to open that lab report before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR report didn't open or the batch number didn't match the box, I'd skip it. A creator I follow showing the report on camera would push me to buy a second box.
